description: This file defines a Java interface for handling write operations related to individual monitoring of group savings accounts within the Fineract project. It declares methods for setting acceptance status, resetting it, incrementing child account count, and adding account information.

classes.name: GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoringWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring write operations related to individual monitoring of group savings accounts.

methods.name: setIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Marks the given monitoring account as accepting child accounts.

methods.name: resetIsAcceptingChild
methods.description: Resets the acceptance status of the given monitoring account.

methods.name: incrementChildAccountCount
methods.description: Increments the count of child accounts associated with the monitoring account.

methods.name: addGSIMAccountInfo
methods.description: Creates and adds a new GroupSavingsIndividualMonitoring account record with provided details.
